The '''repeating crossbow''' was a [[Crossbow/Legends|crossbow]] made of modern materials capable of firing multiple shots.

==Description==
Designed by [[Drolan Plasteel]], the repeating crossbow looked like a cross between a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]]. Crafted out of lightweight [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]], the crossbow weighed very little, and was equipped with an underslung bin holding ten [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]] or quarrels. Upon firing, a new quarrel was automatically loaded into the weapons firing groove and the bowstring was automatically recocked, allowing for multiple shots without pause.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide" /> The repeating crossbow magazine held 10 quarrels. Each magazine cost 30 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed 1.2 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> A variant of the repeating crossbow was the [[Auto-caster]].

The repeating crossbow was used by hunters but was also a collector's item for historical aficionados.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
